title: PADE Intent Manifest
description: v0.1 stub schema for the PADE Intent Specification (portable pade.yaml). Deliberately small; prefer Dev Containers for environment definition. Capability-focused fields are the primary v0.1 surface; environment/services remain optional for compatibility with earlier design drafts. See spec/intent.md.

version.description: PADE manifest version. Fixed to 0.1 for the prototype.

devcontainer.description: Path to a Dev Container config. Prefer DevPod/Dev Containers to own lifecycle; this field is optional in the capability-first direction.

capabilities.description: Named capability requests. Values describe required authority, never credentials.

access.description: Access intent such as read or write.

provider.description: Optional binding hint for prototypes (e.g. env, vault). Prefer user/org-level bindings long term.

env.description: For provider=env demos: required environment variable names (not values).
